nodes.name: Sign Page (GET)
nodes.notes: El enlace del correo abre esta página. Un GET (un escáner de correo, una vista previa) NUNCA firma: solo muestra el contrato.

parameters.query: SELECT (SELECT to_jsonb(k) FROM onb_contracts k WHERE k.client_id = $1) AS contract, (SELECT to_jsonb(c) FROM onb_clients c WHERE c.client_id = $1) AS client_row

nodes.name: Load For Page
nodes.notes: Contrato y cliente.

nodes.name: Render Page
nodes.notes: DETERMINÍSTICO: token válido y contrato por firmar → muestra el contrato y el botón; si no, un mensaje claro sin filtrar datos.

nodes.name: Sign Submit (POST)
nodes.notes: Botón "I agree and sign" de la página. En live lo sustituye el webhook del proveedor de firma electrónica (contrato SIN verificar).

nodes.name: Parse Submit
nodes.notes: Acepta formulario o JSON. "now" solo en mock.

parameters.query: SELECT (SELECT to_jsonb(k) FROM onb_contracts k WHERE k.client_id = $1) AS contract, (SELECT to_jsonb(c) FROM onb_clients c WHERE c.client_id = $1) AS client_row

nodes.name: Load Contract
nodes.notes: Contrato (token, caducidad, firma) y cliente.

nodes.name: Verify Signature
nodes.notes: DETERMINÍSTICO: token igual al del contrato (uno vacío nunca coincide), no caducado y el cliente esperando la firma. Repetir una firma es idempotente; una firma a medias se REANUDA.

parameters.query:
WITH k AS (UPDATE onb_contracts SET signed_at = $3::timestamptz WHERE client_id = $1 AND token = $2 AND signed_at IS NULL AND expires_at >= $3::timestamptz RETURNING client_id),
c AS (UPDATE onb_clients SET status = 'provisioning', updated_at = now(), version = version + 1 WHERE client_id = $1 AND status = 'awaiting_signature' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM k) RETURNING client_id),
s AS (INSERT INTO onb_steps (client_id, step, status, execution_id) SELECT client_id, 'signed', 'ok', $4 FROM c ON CONFLICT (client_id, step) DO NOTHING RETURNING client_id),
e AS (INSERT INTO onb_events (client_id, event, actor, detail) SELECT client_id, 'signed', 'client', '{}'::jsonb FROM c RETURNING id)
SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM c) AS signed

nodes.name: Sign Atomic
nodes.notes: La firma es atómica y de un solo uso: token igual, sin firma previa, sin caducar. Pasa el cliente a "provisioning" y deja el evento, en UNA sentencia.

nodes.name: Render Signed
nodes.notes: Si dos firmas llegan a la vez, solo una gana; la otra recibe "ya firmado" y no repite el aprovisionamiento.

nodes.name: Render Resume
nodes.notes: La firma ya estaba registrada pero el aprovisionamiento no terminó: se reanuda sin firmar otra vez.

nodes.name: Render Other
nodes.notes: Token inválido (403), caducado (410), cliente desconocido (404), estado no firmable (409) o ya firmado (200): una respuesta clara y no se toca nada.

nodes.name: Plan Provisioning
nodes.notes: DETERMINÍSTICO: carpeta, proyecto, tareas de la plantilla del paquete más las que salen de las notas (solo requisitos con cita verificada), fechas en días laborables con festivos, etapa de CRM y secuencia de bienvenida.

parameters.query:
WITH a AS (INSERT INTO onb_assets (client_id, folder) VALUES ($1, $2) ON CONFLICT (client_id) DO NOTHING RETURNING client_id),
s AS (INSERT INTO onb_steps (client_id, step, status, detail, execution_id) VALUES ($1, 'folder', 'ok', jsonb_build_object('folder', $2::text), $3)
  ON CONFLICT (client_id, step) DO UPDATE SET status = 'ok', error = NULL, detail = EXCLUDED.detail, execution_id = EXCLUDED.execution_id, created_at = now() RETURNING client_id)
SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM s) AS recorded

nodes.name: Step · Folder
nodes.notes: Carpeta del cliente (mock de Drive). Idempotente.

parameters.query:
WITH p AS (INSERT INTO onb_projects (project_id, client_id, name) VALUES ($1, $1, $2) ON CONFLICT (project_id) DO NOTHING RETURNING project_id),
t AS (INSERT INTO onb_tasks (client_id, title, due_date, owner_role, source) SELECT $1, x->>'title', (x->>'due_date')::date, x->>'owner_role', x->>'source' FROM jsonb_array_elements($3::jsonb) x
      ON CONFLICT (client_id, title) DO NOTHING RETURNING id),
s AS (INSERT INTO onb_steps (client_id, step, status, detail, execution_id) VALUES ($1, 'project', 'ok', jsonb_build_object('tasks', jsonb_array_length($3::jsonb)), $4)
  ON CONFLICT (client_id, step) DO UPDATE SET status = 'ok', error = NULL, detail = EXCLUDED.detail, execution_id = EXCLUDED.execution_id, created_at = now() RETURNING client_id)
SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM s) AS recorded, (SELECT count(*) FROM t) AS tasks_created

nodes.name: Step · Project and tasks
nodes.notes: Proyecto y tareas (mock del gestor de proyectos). Una tarea con el mismo título no se duplica.

parameters.query:
WITH u AS (UPDATE onb_clients SET crm_stage = $2, updated_at = now() WHERE client_id = $1 RETURNING client_id),
s AS (INSERT INTO onb_steps (client_id, step, status, detail, execution_id) VALUES ($1, 'crm', 'ok', jsonb_build_object('stage', $2::text), $3)
  ON CONFLICT (client_id, step) DO UPDATE SET status = 'ok', error = NULL, detail = EXCLUDED.detail, execution_id = EXCLUDED.execution_id, created_at = now() RETURNING client_id)
SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM s) AS recorded

nodes.name: Step · CRM
nodes.notes: Etapa del CRM a "Onboarding".

parameters.query:
WITH o AS (INSERT INTO onb_outbox (client_id, kind, send_after) SELECT $1, x->>'kind', (x->>'send_after')::timestamptz FROM jsonb_array_elements($2::jsonb) x
      ON CONFLICT (client_id, kind) DO NOTHING RETURNING id),
s AS (INSERT INTO onb_steps (client_id, step, status, detail, execution_id) VALUES ($1, 'sequence', 'ok', jsonb_build_object('messages', jsonb_array_length($2::jsonb)), $3)
  ON CONFLICT (client_id, step) DO UPDATE SET status = 'ok', error = NULL, detail = EXCLUDED.detail, execution_id = EXCLUDED.execution_id, created_at = now() RETURNING client_id)
SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM s) AS recorded, (SELECT count(*) FROM o) AS scheduled

nodes.name: Step · Welcome sequence
nodes.notes: Programa bienvenida, seguimiento y recordatorio del arranque. Los envía onboarding-sequence respetando bajas y horario.

nodes.name: Notify Team
nodes.notes: Aviso al equipo con carpeta, proyecto y tareas. En live: Slack. Si falla, el paso queda "failed" y el cliente NO se activa.

parameters.query:
INSERT INTO onb_steps (client_id, step, status, error, execution_id) VALUES ($1, 'team_notified', CASE WHEN $2::boolean THEN 'ok' ELSE 'failed' END, NULLIF($3, ''), $4)
ON CONFLICT (client_id, step) DO UPDATE SET status = EXCLUDED.status, error = EXCLUDED.error, execution_id = EXCLUDED.execution_id, created_at = now() RETURNING client_id

nodes.name: Step · Team notified
nodes.notes: Se registra DESPUÉS de enviar.

parameters.query:
WITH u AS (UPDATE onb_clients SET status = 'active', updated_at = now(), version = version + 1
  WHERE client_id = $1 AND status IN ('provisioning', 'provisioning_failed')
    AND (SELECT count(*) FROM onb_steps WHERE client_id = $1 AND step IN ('folder', 'project', 'crm', 'sequence', 'team_notified') AND status = 'ok') = 5 RETURNING client_id),
e AS (INSERT INTO onb_events (client_id, event, actor, detail) SELECT client_id, 'activated', 'system', '{}'::jsonb FROM u RETURNING id)
SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM u) AS activated,
       COALESCE((SELECT string_agg(step, ',' ORDER BY step) FROM onb_steps WHERE client_id = $1 AND status <> 'ok'), '') AS not_ok

nodes.name: Activate
nodes.notes: Activa al cliente solo si los cinco pasos están en ok.

nodes.name: Assert Setup
nodes.notes: Falla ruidosamente si algún paso no quedó en ok → Error Handler. Nada se da por hecho en silencio.

parameters.content:
## Onboarding · Signature & Setup
The contract page only SHOWS the contract on a GET; signing is a POST with a one-time token. After signing, code sets up the folder, project and tasks, CRM stage and welcome sequence step by step, each idempotent and recorded. The client becomes active only when every step is ok, and calling the signature again resumes whatever is missing.
